description: Full Stack Engineer (Python / React) with Agentic AI Experience Intelligence Experts LLC | Doha, Qatar | Full-time | On-site Monthly Salary: USD 2,000 – 3,500 POSITION OVERVIEW We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of professional software development experience and strong hands-on expertise in Python, React, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
